summary: Implemented cached, non-mutating CLI authentication preflight for every configured coding-agent profile, with selector fallback, structured logging, dashboard status, operator nudges, and coverage for the required failure modes.
testsRun: dotnet test SoftwareFactory.slnx --no-build (unfiltered; seven unrelated baseline failures)
risks: The unfiltered dotnet test command still has seven pre-existing Windows-worktree failures: six ProcessRunnerTests invoke the POSIX-only sh executable, and RepositoryBootstrapTests expects CRLF while the renderer emits LF. All task-focused suites and the other assemblies pass.

The repository-wide npm run lint scan was stopped after it hung in the shared workspace; targeted eslint for the changed frontend file passed. Authentication checks use configured provider status commands and never start login or refresh credentials.
